# ASCENDANT — Worklog

## Project Overview
A gamified body-fitness progression app inspired by "hunter system" RPG tropes (leveling, ranks, gates, quests, titles) — **not** featuring Solo Leveling IP. Original branding: **ASCENDANT — Awakened Training Protocol**.

- Stack: Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, Prisma + SQLite, Zustand, Framer Motion, Recharts
- Route: single `/` SPA with 5 client-side tabs (STATUS / DIRECTIVES / GATES / RECORDS / TITLES)
- Theme: permanently dark "system window" aesthetic — violet/fuchsia accents (no blue/indigo), glowing corner-bracket panels, scanlines, mono typography

---
Task ID: 1
Agent: main (Z.ai Code)
Task: Full initial build of ASCENDANT fitness leveling app

Work Log:
- Designed Prisma schema (Hunter, Quest, WorkoutSession, ExerciseLog, Achievement, XpEvent) and pushed to SQLite (`bun run db:push`)
- Built game engine libs:
  - `src/lib/game.ts` — ranks F→S, XP curve (`80 + (lvl-1)*45`), applyXp with level-ups, stat XP formulas per exercise type, combat power, 4 archetypes
  - `src/lib/gates.ts` — 5 gate domains (Gale Fields cardio ×1.1, Iron Forge strength ×1.25, Titan's Trial calisthenics ×1.2, Sanctum of Flow mobility ×1.0, Colossus Gate mixed ×1.6) with 26 exercise templates
  - `src/lib/quests.ts` — 8 daily templates (deterministic daily roll: raid + 3) + 15 main milestones
  - `src/lib/titles.ts` — 18 titles in 4 tiers
  - `src/lib/engine.ts` — server engine: grantXp (levels/ranks/stat points/streak/ledger), ensureQuests (daily refresh + stale fail), syncQuests (aggregate recompute), checkAchievements (context-aware: night-raider, dawn-wolf, century, marathon-mind)
- API routes (all force-dynamic, JSON):
  - `/api/hunter` GET/POST(awaken)/PATCH(equip title, rename)
  - `/api/hunter/stats` POST (allocate points)
  - `/api/quests` GET (auto-refresh dailies + sync), POST (claim | manual check)
  - `/api/sessions` GET (active+history), POST (enter gate)
  - `/api/sessions/[id]` POST (add-log | remove-log | complete | abandon)
  - `/api/achievements` GET, `/api/history` GET (14-day XP ledger + recent raids)
- Frontend: `src/store/system-store.ts` (Zustand: tab, notices, reward overlay, global refreshKey), `src/hooks/use-api.ts` (fetch + auto-refetch on refreshKey)
- System UI kit: SystemPanel (corner brackets), RankBadge (diamond), XPBar (shine anim), NotificationStack, RewardOverlay (count-up XP, LEVEL UP / RANK ASCENSION / title unlocks), BootScreen
- Feature tabs: AwakeningScreen (onboarding ritual), StatusTab (hunter card + stat allocation + daily summary + raid log), DirectivesTab (dailies + main milestones), GatesTab + SessionRaid (gate cards, live timer, quick-deploy exercise chips, exercise dialog with live XP estimate, projected clear yield, clear/abandon), RecordsTab (Recharts XP area chart + totals + archive), TitlesTab (grid + equip)
- Nav: sticky TopNav (desktop tabs + live LV/rank/XP) + fixed BottomNav (mobile, safe-area aware); footer sticky via `mt-auto` (desktop)
- globals.css: full dark system theme (oklch violet tokens), sys-panel/corners, xp-shine, scanlines, gate-drift, glow-breathe, custom scrollbars

Stage Summary:
- Dev server runs on :3000, `bun run lint` 0 errors, `bunx tsc --noEmit` clean (src/)
- E2E verified via agent-browser: awaken (KAEL/Titanblood) → enter Titan's Trial → log push-ups (XP estimate 49) → clear gate (89 XP → LEVEL 2 + 3 stat points) → claim Raid Directive (+60 XP) → allocate STR ×2 → equip title → records chart + titles grid all render; mobile 390px layout + bottom nav OK; no console/page errors in dev.log
- Screenshots in `/home/z/my-project/screenshots/` (status, reward, records, titles, mobile)
- DB currently has test hunter KAEL (lv 2, 1 raid). To reset: `bunx prisma db push --force-reset` style reset or delete hunter row.

Unresolved issues / risks:
- DevTools overlay button from Next.js may appear in snapshots (harmless)
- Old `src/app/api/route.ts` health endpoint remains (harmless)
- No data export/import yet; no workout timer beyond session elapsed
- Next phase ideas: rest-day mechanic, weekly gate rotation, PR tracking per exercise, share card, TTS system announcer, LLM-powered "System advisor"
